phases.label: RMA
phases.title: Return Authorization
phases.desc: Customer requests a return and an RMA is issued through the system.
steps: Return shipping label created in FreightPOP

phases.label: Transit
phases.title: Return In-Transit
phases.desc: Inbound return tracked from customer location to warehouse.
steps: Customer drops off or schedules pickup
Return shipment tracked in real time
Expected arrival date communicated to warehouse

phases.label: Receive
phases.title: Returns Receiving & Inspection
phases.desc: Warehouse inspects returned item and routes it based on condition.

phases.label: Close
phases.title: Close Loop in ERP
phases.desc: ERP updated to close the return and credit the customer.
